A **Crossbow** is a ranged weapon in *Fallout 76*.

A sturdy crossbow with metal limbs and a wooden stock. While the crossbow deals high amounts of damage, it can only have one bolt loaded at a time, with the exception of the Nuclear Winter game mode, in which it could hold a maximum of three. As all other bows, the Crossbow is a silent weapon, meaning that it has a sneak attack functionality similar to that of a Suppressor.
